The playlist dropdowns now look and feel like Spotify, and the taskbar finally does something: the Start button opens a real menu, and every icon in the tray opens its own panel.
+ Spotify-style dropdowns in the playlist tab with a green outline, green highlight and a checkmark on the selected option
+ Start menu with pinned apps, app search and a restart button
+ Volume panel in the tray with a slider, mute and now playing controls
+ Calendar panel when you click the clock
+ Network panel that shows online status and offline mode
+ Hidden icons panel with a bass boost switch and shortcuts
- Clicking the tray speaker no longer mutes right away, it opens the volume panel instead
* Changelog is now one simple list: headline, description, then + - * lines
